style: An Italian Renaissance fresco-like oil painting of 58 BC in the manner of Raphael's workshop and Giulio Romano: classical Greco-Roman figures modelled like antique sculpture, powerful horses in motion, a monumental composition, warm earth colours, luminous sky. Roman cavalry in mail and bronze helmets. One single painting filling the whole 16:9 frame, no text, signature, border or black bars.

people.caesar: Julius Caesar, lean, bald crown with thin hair combed forward, clean-shaven, red general's cloak over a bronze muscled cuirass
people.divico: Divico, an aged Helvetian war-leader with long white hair and a long white moustache, gold torc, checked cloak
people.dumnorix: Dumnorix of the Aedui, long fair hair, drooping moustache, gold torc, rich checked cloak
people.divitiacus: Divitiacus, an Aeduan druid with long grey-brown hair and a moustache, white robe, gold torc

beats.text: Julius Caesar riding at full gallop along a Roman road in southern Gaul with a small escort of cavalry in red cloaks, dust rising, cypresses and vineyards beside the road, hard bright sun.Roman legionaries wear mail shirts, bronze Montefortino helmets and curved oval shields; Gauls have long hair, moustaches, checked trousers, cloaks and torcs.
